narrative.overview: Owner-selected refined A: mature, simple flat illustration with adult-proportioned troops, an olive company standard and warm stone terrain.
dos: Keep scenery quieter than characters and decisions.
Preserve progress and saves, including on defeat.
donts: Do not reintroduce realistic illustrations, chibi proportions, dense floating labels or ornate fantasy chrome.
Do not describe a generated concept as the working game.
